# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: So you've come, apostles of the $$大邪神$$!!
Mr. $$ケルビム$$, this isn't true, is it!?
That you're a member of the $$教団$$... that you're an $$大天使$$!!
B-$$バアル$$, you bastard!!
You, of all people, I'll reduce to ashes, body and all!
Or would you rather be ground into mince along with $$ルカ$$!?
Hmph. I'll tie you to a chair alive and flay every scrap of flesh from your bones!
$$ユダ$$, I never imagined you too were an $$大天使$$.
My, if it's $$嫉妬$$ you want, I can give you plenty more.
Before you revived with that armor, you were only a pathetic old queen!!
That's right!!
Since you've forgotten, let me remind you what you did to me!!
July 6: “I'll tell you about $$お師匠さま$$,” he said as he approached me. Was he after my body?
July 7: He took my clothes without permission...
Enough, be quiet! What a noisy little girl!!
I have no intention of listening to any more of your nonsense!
You $$罪$$ners who praise the $$邪神$$! Know the weight of your $$罪$$!!
Aaaaaaah!!
G-ghaaaaah! W-what is this!?
Fuhahahahaha!!!
To fall into the same trap as in the $$創世記戦争$$... What fools!!
I-I can't move my body...
Fuhahahahaha!!
You came toddling right into the trap yourselves... What fools!!
Within this $$教皇庁$$ is a powerful barrier Lord $$メフィスト$$ set long ago!!
Y-you bastards...
You walked right into it, $$ヨハネ$$!!
From the very beginning, I never believed you were the reincarnation of that great Lord $$メフィスト$$...
Not for a moment!!
Inside this barrier... evaporate and vanish!!
